name: Helio
source:
"A young and obliging guy always ready to lend a hand, especially if he can get closer to you in the process.

He dreams about becoming the hero who will solve all the mysteries surrounding the incident—saving everyone in the process.

All these ideas come from him being a nerd, but it does not change how kind-hearted he is."
